run.head_commit_message:
refactor(sim): the swaps under way held by the crate (spec 39 step 8b4-v) (#622)

* refactor(sim): the swaps under way held by the crate (spec 39 step 8b4-v)

Each squad's swaps under way (swaps::Held) are a squad column the snapshot
carries, units by id and store slot. The crate ends them (end_held), starts
them round those held (claims, begin; squad_start_moves replaces
CrateMarch's start_moves), and answers each unit's offset and the moves
compact closes up round. A unit's state is mirrored in the store's STATE
column by UnitState, its one writer, so the crate knows who still stands.
Records 8b4-v's split into 8b4-v, 8b4-vi and 8b4-vii. An identical port:
outcomes unchanged.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_011AyPi4WDcUy1No1CjVJ1ah

* fix(sim): give UnitView the store's state column (spec 39 step 8b4-v)

8b4-v added UnitColumns.STATE, and test_unit_view holds every column to a
typed property of its own on UnitView: state is PackedInt32Array, as the
other int columns are.

The PR modifies 14 pre-existing files, over the OCP check's 11: the swaps
held by the crate change how every reader of them reaches them (the
shuffle, compact, the taking-in, the split, the turn, the rout, the ranks
and the squad's view), and the unit's state mirror adds a column to the
store's three column lists and its one writer.

Waived-by: Decision 157

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_011AyPi4WDcUy1No1CjVJ1ah

* refactor(sim): the taking held by the crate (spec 39 step 8b4-vi) (#623)

* refactor(sim): the taking held by the crate, in progress (spec 39 step 8b4-vi)

Each squad's units out taking the downed are a squad column (taker's id,
its body's store slot) the snapshot carries; SkirmishSquad.taking is a view
of it, read and written whole. FormationTaking reads a body's state from
the store's mirrored STATE column. The spec and README entries, and the
gdUnit test's red run, are still to come before the PR.

* refactor(sim): spawning's ids and the order queue in the crate (spec 39 step 8b4-vii) (#624)

The orders given for the next tick are queued in the crate
(orders::queue, Squads::pending), a second order for a squad replacing
the first where it stands; apply_orders takes the queue itself. The
battle's squad and unit ids are issued by the crate (issue_squad,
issue_units), both carried by the snapshot. An identical port: outcomes
unchanged.

* refactor(sim): the units' numbers held by the crate (spec 39 step 8b5-i)

Each unit's 42 numbers (every int, float and bool of SkirmishUnit but its
id, slot and state) live in the unit store by slot (sheet.rs, the columns'
`sheet`), carried by the snapshot. UnitStore.admit gives the unit its slot
and writes them whole; each SkirmishUnit setter writes its own after; a
unit the store lets go writes no more. The unit keeps the copy it reads,
as no crate pass writes them yet. Nothing reads the sheet yet: outcomes
unchanged.

Splits 8b5-i further: 8b5-ii is now the units' words, lists and objects,
and the rest of 8b5 is renumbered to 8b5-iii to 8b5-ix.

* refactor(sim): the units' words and lists held by the crate (spec 39 step 8b5-ii)

Each unit's twelve words and lists (faction, damage type, tags, tactics,
weaknesses, resistances, immunities, what stops its regeneration, its
attributes and traits with their levels, and its weapons' parts) live in
the unit store by slot (words.rs, the columns' `words`), each word coded
once for the field by its lexicon, carried by the snapshot. UnitStore.admit
writes them whole with the numbers (UnitWrites, which now holds the
writing); each SkirmishUnit setter writes its own after, and a trait set in
place goes through set_trait. Nothing reads them yet: outcomes unchanged.

Splits 8b5-ii further: 8b5-iii is now the units' objects (walker, command
and origin, definition), and the rest of 8b5 is renumbered to 8b5-iv to
8b5-x.

* refactor(sim): the units' objects coded for the crate (spec 39 step 8b5-iii) (#627)

Each unit's walker (its TerrainWalker fields), the command it follows and
the one it started under (their command slots) and its definition (its code
in the unit store's own list, the order first seen) are now held by the
crate in the unit store by slot (objects.rs, the columns' `objects`),
carried by the snapshot. The definitions stay GDScript's, by code
(UnitStore.definition_of). UnitStore.admit writes them whole with the
numbers and words (UnitWrites, now given the store); each SkirmishUnit
setter writes its own after. Nothing reads them yet: outcomes unchanged.

* refactor(sim): the events as data and the orders' pass in the crate (spec 39 step 8b5-v) (#629)

The crate builds events in a log (events.rs), taken flat and decoded by
CrateEvents into the dictionaries FormationEvents made. The orders' pass
(orders/pass.rs) now reads a retreat's pursuing and its units' discipline
from the crate (discipline.rs, on their sheets), lands the ragged shock
(shocks.rs) and builds the orders' events; FormationOrders keeps only the
pursuers' routes. Records 8b5-v's further split in the spec.

* refactor(sim): engagement's events and shocks built in the crate (spec 39 step 8b5-vi) (#630)

The front and flank locks already decided in the crate; now they report there
too (contact/pass.rs). Each front lock picked is its attacker's "engaged"
event; each flank lock its victim's "flanked" event, then the shock of its
edge (shocks.rs). FormationFronts and FormationEdges take the events through
CrateEvents. BandTuning hands the crate morale's tuning for FormationMorale,
FormationOrders and FormationEdges alike.

Splits 8b5-vi further: pathing moves on to 8b5-vii, and the rest renumber.
Outcomes unchanged.

* refactor(sim): pathing as a crate pass (spec 39 step 8b5-vii) (#631)

FormationPathing hands the crate its squads and the ground (path_step):
the follows of the commands' patched routes, which now set each group's
route and place in the crate, then the marching groups' looks, each way
round learned by the command and reported as its "detoured" event in the
crate's log (pathing/pass.rs). A look reads each unit's walker, wits,
place and definition's sight where they live; UnitWrites writes a
definition's sight to the field as it codes it (put_sight), and
CratePaths.members reads the same (path_members). path_follows,
path_follow, path_looks and GroundPaths.look_ahead are gone.

Outcomes unchanged.

* refactor(sim): the move's march as a crate pass (spec 39 step 8b5-viii) (#632)

FormationSimulation hands the crate the tick's roster, each squad's
share of its pace and its route's code (move_step): staging, the march's
ends, the hold, the turn, the sweep, the pace, the drag and the landing
run there (moving/pass.rs), their events ("staged", "signalled",
"gave_up", "arrived", "returned", "turning", "turned", "blocked") built
in the crate's log and decoded by CrateEvents as before. A coordinated
leader's slack is read from the sheets, each front rank's walkers from
their objects, the bodies lying from the store. The squads that advanced
come back for FormationJoins.

move_holds, move_land, staging_hold, march_sweep and GroundMarch's
toward, travel_sign and pace are gone, with FormationStaging.holds,
FormationSweep.step and FormationMarch's length, pace, toward and
travel_sign. The split of 8b5-viii (the walk's share and the joins next,
8b5-ix) is recorded in the spec.

Outcomes unchanged.

* refactor(sim): the walk's share read in the crate (spec 39 step 8b5-ix)

The move pass works out each squad's share of its pace itself
(moving/share.rs), reading each unit's place, footprint, walker and swap
where they live, the rule from its traits and leadership, and the slack
from its discipline. FormationSimulation._keeping, MOVE_GOES, the
move_choices binding and GroundMarch.share are gone; FormationWalk.share
reads the crate's (walk_share). Splits 8b5-ix: the joins pass on as 8b5-x.

* test(sim): re-slotted units take what the crate holds of them along (spec 39 step 8b5-ix)

test_units_given_other_slots_play_the_same_battle hands every unit another
slot and copies its UnitColumns across, but not what the crate holds of it
since 8b5-i (its numbers, words, lists and objects) or its squad's members'
slots in the squad store. The walk's share is the first pass to read both
from the crate, so the shuffled battle parted from the usual one at tick 86.
The fixture now does what admission does: each unit re-delivers its sheet to
its new slot (hold_sheet) and each squad re-lists its members (regather).
The battle code is unchanged; the simulation never re-slots a unit.
